title: Pandora Hearts Specials
justification: AniList 6896 (SPECIAL, 9 episode(s) from 2009-07-24) is AniDB 6288's special(s) S1-S9, aired 2009-07-24 to 2010-03-25. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 6288. The parent node has no mapping rows, so S1-S9 default to TVDB 0x1-0x9.
